**Sophie Zwartsenberg** is a dendrochronologist and tropical ecologist from
Prof. Pieter Zuidema's lab at Wageningen University in the Netherlands. She is
visiting the BioM2 Lab for three months, working on developing a process-based
wood growth module for ED2 and other models. Welcome Sophie!
